reason: I grab my energy cans at the petrol station while driving or order them with my supplements on GymBeam or Vilgain, and this is in neither place. I'm not ordering from a separate e-shop for one drink at 55 CZK when a Monster at the pump costs less and gives me more caffeine before training.
objection: It's not where I actually buy, and the English label makes me wonder whether it's even a Czech product or just a pricey import. 80 mg is also on the light side next to my pre-workout.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at the petrol stations I stop at, or listed on Vilgain or GymBeam so I can add it to my usual order, at around 45 CZK.
